data.description:
# Context
Operator-declared serious bug (2026-08-12): **advisory code-review findings are sometimes invisible on the Gerrit change.** The review-bot's vote message states a count ("PASS. N advisory finding(s) (non-blocking)") but on some changes the finding TEXT is retrievable nowhere on the change — no robot comments, no inline comments, nothing in the vote message body.

Observed tonight (all RebarBotNava changes, LLM-Review +1):
- change **1666** — "4 advisory non-blocking findings — their text isn't exposed via the Gerrit API"; agent could not inspect them.
- change **1685** — "Gerrit has no robot comments and no inline comments for 1685"; only the count was published.
- Counter-example: change **1636** — advisories WERE posted as inline comments ("Advisories aren't in the message body (inline comments only)"). So posting is INCONSISTENT, not uniformly absent.

Why it matters (operator, verbatim): "if they're invisible it makes it difficult for us to determine which advisory findings should be promoted to blocking." This directly feeds the pending blocking-lane re-enable work (childsafe comment #10: 183 major/critical findings all landed advisory; deciding which criteria to blocking-enable requires the advisory corpus to be visible where reviewers look).

The finding data DOES exist in the tracker's REVIEW_RESULT sidecar events — the gap is on the Gerrit publishing surface (review-bot vote/comment posting path).

# Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC1 — Root cause identified: under what conditions does the review-bot publish advisory finding text vs only a count (diff 1636's path vs 1666/1685's — e.g. inline-comment anchoring failure when a finding lacks a file/line anchor, comment-posting error swallowed, or a path/branch condition).
- [ ] AC2 — Advisory findings are ALWAYS retrievable from the Gerrit change: each advisory posts as an inline/robot comment when anchorable, and falls back to enumerated text in the review message body when not (anchor-less findings must not be dropped from the surface).
- [ ] AC3 — A posting failure is never silent: if publishing any finding fails, the vote message says so and names where the full set lives (the ticket's REVIEW_RESULT sidecar).
- [ ] AC4 — Regression tests pin: anchorable finding → inline comment; anchor-less finding → message-body text; posting-error path → explicit notice. RED-verified against the reproduced 1666/1685 condition.
- [ ] AC5 — make lint/typecheck pass; no change to vote semantics (labels, blocking behavior).
data.title: Advisory review findings sometimes invisible on the Gerrit change
